raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Fix two incompatibilities between unified cache and DeepSeek V4: 1. Current runs have revealed the need to check unaligned truncation boundaries, so as to prevent the end of the previous interval from overlapping the start of the following interval. 2. For the DeepSeek V4 NPU platform, independent C128 cache management is used. When performing alignment truncation, the C128 alignment length (128*14=2048) must be taken into account. The floor_cache_len in the component is invoked in the unified cache. ## Modifications 1. Add a new floor_cache_len interface to the component and invoke it in the unified cache. 2. boundary checks; if the boundaries overlap, merge them into a single interval. splited from: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38251 ## Accuracy Tests ## Speed Tests and Profiling has no impact ## Checklist - [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :white_check_mark: [Run #35009147616](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35009147616) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #35009147036](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35009147036) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #35009147450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35009147450)
